# GUI Interface Description

## Application
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Writer
- **Operating System**: Ubuntu (visible from the sidebar icons and top bar design)

---

## Main Window Layout
### Title Bar
- **Title**: "04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing info 2021 Jan.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
- **Menu Options**: 
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help
- **Minimize, Maximize, and Close Buttons**: Located at the top-right corner.

### Toolbar
- **Formatting Toolbar**:
  - Font Style: "Calibri"
  - Font Size: "12 pt"
  - Text Formatting Options:
    - Bold
    - Italic
    - Underline
    - Strikethrough
    - Subscript
    - Superscript
  - Text Alignment Options:
    - Left Align
    - Center Align
    - Right Align
    - Justify
  - Line Spacing Options
  - Bulleted and Numbered Lists
  - Indentation Options
  - Highlight Color
  - Font Color
- **Additional Toolbar Options**:
  - Insert Table
  - Insert Image
  - Insert Hyperlink
  - Insert Comment
  - Undo and Redo Buttons

### Document Area
- **Content**:
  - Text: Instructions for purchasing and using an eBook.
  - Formatting:
    - Bold text for emphasis (e.g., "BLCUP eBook").
    - Red underlines indicating spelling or grammar suggestions.
  - Alignment: Left-aligned text.
  - Line Spacing: Default spacing.
- **Page Style**: Default Page Style
- **Language**: English (USA)

### Ruler
- **Horizontal Ruler**: Visible at the top of the document area.
- **Vertical Ruler**: Not visible.

---

## Sidebar
- **Icons**:
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - File Manager
  - Firefox Browser
  - Help Icon
  - Ubuntu Software Center
  - Trash Bin

---

## Notifications
- **Blue Notification Bars**:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Buttons: "Get involved" and "Donate" (on the right side of each bar).

---

## Status Bar
- **Zoom Level**: 173% (visible in the bottom-right corner).
- **Page Information**: "Page 1 of 1".
- **Word Count**: Not displayed.

---

## Additional Observations
- **Cursor Position**: Visible in the document area, indicating where text can be entered.
- **Spelling Suggestions**: Words like "eBook" and "OPZ" are underlined in red, suggesting potential spelling issues.
